generated: scripts/game_data.py from the ItemBalance_Classic bonus block and ContinentBonusNames

sources.bonus_mapping: XEW/XComGame/Config/DefaultGameCore.ini, ItemBalance_Classic block under "Starter, Country and Continent bonuses". eItem 0 = starting bonus, 1 = country bonus (active while that country has satellite coverage), 2 = continent bonus (needs full coverage). iTime is the bonus id, iEng its value. The same block applies at every difficulty.
sources.names_and_descriptions: XEW/XComGame/Localization/INT/XComStrategyGame.int, ContinentBonusNames[id] and ContinentBonusDesc[id]; <XGParam:IntValue0> in the description is filled with the config value.
sources.countries: TCountry structs on XGCountry actors in the save (iEnum is the country id used by the config). Starting cash per country from the "Initial Cash Amounts" block of the ini, before the difficulty multiplier.
sources.effects: Bonus effects are implemented in the game scripts; the description text is what the game shows.

save_fields.continent_bonus: XGContinent.m_eBonus (vanilla EContinentBonus enum name, one per continent; Long War reuses these slots for its own bonuses)
save_fields.starting_bonus: not stored by name; the game keeps the starting country and derives the bonus from the config
save_fields.country_bonus: not stored; a country bonus is active while XGCountry has a satellite

bonus.name: Air Superiority
bonus.config_comment: Grants increased fire rate of aircraft

bonus.name: Fear No Evil
bonus.description: Countries are 20% more resistant to increases in panic. Countries that have left the XCOM project still provide 1 credit per day.
bonus.config_comment: % reduction in worldwide panic increases and prevents income stoppage from countries that left the XCOM project

bonus.name: New Warfare
bonus.description: Foundry projects have cash, alloy and elerium cost reduced by 40%. Combat Patrols have their incremental cost reduced by 15%.

bonus.name: Architects of the Future
bonus.description: Laboratories and Workshops have 75% reduced upkeep cost. Research speed and equipment build speed is increased by 10%.
bonus.config_comment: % reduction in lab and workshop cost

starting_bonuses.name: Random Start
starting_bonuses.description: Selects a random location and bonus for XCOM's headquarters.

starting_bonuses.name: Vigilis
starting_bonuses.description: All biosoldiers start with +16 base will.

starting_bonuses.name: Endless Magazines
starting_bonuses.description: Infantry and Assaults have a 15% chance for any shot to cost 0 AP and gain +4 ammo on primary weapons and +2 ammo on pistols. Your starting country's first 2 soldiers begin at SPEC rank as Tactical (Infantry/Assault). PFC promotions go to Tactical whenever another supraclass outnumbers it.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: Infantry and Assaults gain +2 ammo to non-arc primary weapons

starting_bonuses.name: Public Heroes
starting_bonuses.description: Gain double credit, scientist, and engineer rewards from abductions. Grants an additional unit to aid in abductions.

starting_bonuses.name: Per Ardua Ad Astra
starting_bonuses.description: All biosoldiers start with +1 base HP, +3 base aim, and +5 base will. Soldiers acquired later in the campaign gain double the bonus attributes that are normally gained for each month passed.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: # General ability point bonus on soldier creation

starting_bonuses.name: Robotics
starting_bonuses.description: +20 base aim for SHIVs and MECs.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: # bonus aim for new SHIVs and MECs

starting_bonuses.name: Endless Barrage
starting_bonuses.description: Gunners gain +5 ammo. Rocketeers gain +25 penetration on rockets and +2 rockets. Your starting country's first 2 soldiers begin at SPEC rank as Weapons (Gunner/Rocketeer). PFC promotions go to Weapons whenever another supraclass outnumbers it.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: Gunners gain +3 ammo to non-arc primary weapons

starting_bonuses.name: Outback Rocketeers
starting_bonuses.description: Rockets cost 0 AP to fire and have 50% less scatter. Your starting country's first 2 soldiers begin at SPEC rank as Weapons (Gunner/Rocketeer). PFC promotions go to Weapons whenever another supraclass outnumbers it.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: Firing a rocket costs only 1 AP

starting_bonuses.name: Jungle Scouts
starting_bonuses.description: All biosoldiers start with +0.6 base mobility and their injury times are reduced by 80%. Reaction shots gain +5 aim and +5 crit. Start with Tactical Rigging [Grants one extra utility slot to biosoldier armors other than Phalanx and the Leather Jacket (max 4) -- foundry must be built to benefit].

starting_bonuses.name: Ready For War
starting_bonuses.description: Start with 50 alloys, 50 elerium, and 1 fusion core. Research credits reduce research time by 50% (instead of 20%).
starting_bonuses.config_comment: additive % bonus to research credit bonuses

starting_bonuses.name: Amazonian Strength
starting_bonuses.description: Increases throw range of all XCOM units by 50%.

starting_bonuses.name: Born to Fly
starting_bonuses.description: Pilots gain 5x as much aim per kill (2.5 aim instead of 0.5 aim) and +25 crit. Downed pilots eject and are never killed: they take over the next new aircraft. Reduces the increased cost of housing more than 5 aircraft on a continent by 60%.

starting_bonuses.name: Advanced Preparations
starting_bonuses.description: Start with 8 additional soldiers, all elevators, a workshop (1st floor, just right of elevator), a laboratory (3rd floor, just right of elevator), and a fission generator (1st floor, far right). Start with 15 extra scientists and engineers in your home base.

starting_bonuses.name: Cadre
starting_bonuses.description: Five of the initial PFCs start at the Lance Corporal rank and gain Cadre [When deployed with another Cadre soldier: +25% base weapon damage, and fatigue and injury times after the mission are reduced by 65%]. Active and fatigued soldiers gain xp each day equal to 2x the number of months passed.

starting_bonuses.name: First Responders
starting_bonuses.description: Medics start with 2 extra medikits and can heal with medikits for 0 AP. Medikits heal 2 more HP and have no cooldown. Your starting country's first 2 soldiers begin at SPEC rank as Support (Medic/Engineer). PFC promotions go to Support whenever another supraclass outnumbers it.

starting_bonuses.name: Prepared for Hell
starting_bonuses.description: All XCOM units gain 20% more armor HP from their armor. Medics start with an extra medikit. Engineer Repair has 1 more use. XCOM is immune to heal fatigue. Your starting country's first 2 soldiers begin at SPEC rank as Support (Medic/Engineer). PFC promotions go to Support whenever another supraclass outnumbers it.

starting_bonuses.name: Research Focus
starting_bonuses.description: Start with two laboratories (1st floor, both to the right of the elevator). Removes the maintenance cost of laboratories. Start with 20 extra scientists.

starting_bonuses.name: True North
starting_bonuses.description: No regional bonus. A clean slate for those who need none.

starting_bonuses.name: Assembly Line
starting_bonuses.description: Start with two workshops (1st floor, both to the right of the elevator) and 5 extra engineers in your home base. Removes the maintenance cost of workshops. Manufacturing orders cost 50% less credits, alloys and elerium for any item after the first.

starting_bonuses.name: Red Army Repairs
starting_bonuses.description: Engineer Repair heals 4 more HP and has 2 more uses. Engineers adjacent to SHIVs heal them for 35% of the damage taken (from 25%). SHIVs have no repair time after a mission. Your starting country's first 2 soldiers begin at SPEC rank as Support (Medic/Engineer). PFC promotions go to Support whenever another supraclass outnumbers it.

starting_bonuses.name: Xeno Market
starting_bonuses.description: Credits from selling alien corpses, wrecks, and captives increased by 7x.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: bonus for gray market corpse sales

starting_bonuses.name: Deus Ex
starting_bonuses.description: Acquiring any genetic modification grants both gene mods for that body part. Genetically modifying soldiers occurs twice as fast and costs half as much. Start with 100 meld.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: % of meld and cash cost reduction

starting_bonuses.name: For the Sake of Glory
starting_bonuses.description: All injury and fatigue times are reduced by 35%. Soldiers are three times as likely to receive a quirk (both positive and negative) after a mission.

starting_bonuses.name: Desert Storm
starting_bonuses.description: AP grenades gain +10 penetration and apply 2x as much shred. Equipped AP grenades receive an additional 2 uses.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: HE and AP grenades receive an additional use

starting_bonuses.name: Legionnaire Precision
starting_bonuses.description: Snipers and Scouts gain +15 penetration, +15 aim, and +15 crit. Your starting country's first 2 soldiers begin at SPEC rank as Marksmen (Sniper/Scout). PFC promotions go to Marksman whenever another supraclass outnumbers it.

starting_bonuses.name: Quai d'Orsay
starting_bonuses.description: Country item requests occur 50% faster; fulfilled requests provide 50% additional defense, and intel scans cost 50% less.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: % reduction in intel roll cost, % reduction in time between council requests and % defense bonus from fulfilled requests

starting_bonuses.name: Foreign Legion
starting_bonuses.description: Start with 18 additional soldiers. Reduces soldier salary costs by 35%. Active and fatigued soldiers gain xp each day equal to the number of months passed.

starting_bonuses.name: Skunkworks
starting_bonuses.description: Item production time is reduced by 80%. Start with all elevators, 3 Fission Generators, a Workshop and the Foundry built on the 3rd floor. Start with 10 extra engineers in your home base.

starting_bonuses.name: Waffenmeister
starting_bonuses.description: All shots gain +15 penetration.

starting_bonuses.name: Baumeister
starting_bonuses.description: Start with all elevators built and 2 Elerium Generators built on the 4th floor (right side near the elevator). Elerium Generators have no upkeep cost. Facility construction and MEC augmentation time is reduced by 75%.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: Grants 3 fission generators and % Reduction in facility build time

starting_bonuses.name: NeoPanzers
starting_bonuses.description: MECs and SHIVs start with +4.0 base mobility. 50% reduction in cash, alloy and elerium required for MECs, SHIVs, and their primary weapons.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: % reduction Cash / alloy / elerium for MECs, SHIVs, and their primary weapons

starting_bonuses.name: Militarization
starting_bonuses.description: Start with the Officer Training School built (1st floor, 3rd room in) with Lieutenants and Captains unlocked. Twice the officer billets are unlocked from all OTS upgrades. Officers gain +1 command charges.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: Soldiers cost less, arrive earlier, and bilets are twice as much per rank

starting_bonuses.name: Stormtroopers
starting_bonuses.description: Grants +25% base weapon damage to all shots made within 4 tiles. Pincers that hit set up another pincer instead of being used up.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: +35% damage within 4 tiles, landed pincers set up another

starting_bonuses.name: Jai Vidwan
starting_bonuses.description: Research speed is increased by 10%, and each Laboratory grants an extra 10% research speed. Gain double scientists from all abductions.

starting_bonuses.name: Demolition Doctrine
starting_bonuses.description: All explosives gain +1 damage and +20 penetration. Aliens killed by explosives still leave their corpses.

starting_bonuses.name: Jai Jawan
starting_bonuses.description: Increase aircraft fire rate by 35%. Reduces the increased cost of housing more than 5 aircraft on a continent by 60%.

starting_bonuses.name: Ring of Fire
starting_bonuses.description: Thermogenerators produce 6 credits each day instead of having a maintenance cost. Start with 6 steam vents at the bottom of the 2nd and 5th columns of the base (instead of 1 steam vent at the bottom of the 2nd column).

starting_bonuses.name: Ghost In the Machine
starting_bonuses.description: All SHIVs receive +35 aim. SHIVs can gain quirks.

starting_bonuses.name: Kiryu-Kai Commanders
starting_bonuses.description: Start with 2 additional soldiers: Japanese Master Sergeants of random classes.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: Grants soldier of rank # in random class

starting_bonuses.name: Kiryu-Kai Revival
starting_bonuses.description: XCOM revives the old Kiryu-Kai base and starts with: UFO Analysis: Medium UFOs researched, Beam Lasers researched, 5 Laser Rifles, the Officer Training School built (1st floor, 3rd room in) with XTP I and Lieutenants unlocked.

starting_bonuses.name: Bushido Training
starting_bonuses.description: All biosoldiers gain +10 defense and a 2% chance to enrage each turn they start with an enemy in sight.

starting_bonuses.name: Global Networking
starting_bonuses.description: Grey Market sell prices are 50% higher, and countries are twice as likely to aid in tactical missions with air strikes. Grants an additional unit to aid in Exalt Covert Op Data Recovery and Extraction missions. Start with Grey Market [Gives the ability to sell various equipment and artifacts XCOM has obtained].
starting_bonuses.config_comment: Intel Scans cost only 20 credits, Grey Market Prices are higher, % bonus in monthly satellite-based funding

starting_bonuses.name: Wealthy Benefactor
starting_bonuses.description: Start with 800 bonus cash. All soldier salaries are covered by the Benefactor. Council loans are 3x as large and have 10% the surcharge.

starting_bonuses.name: Ancient Artifacts
starting_bonuses.description: Start the campaign with 500 meld, an Illuminator Scope, Cognitive Enhancer, and Neuroregulator. Also start with a Blaster Launcher and Fusion Lance that can only be used after unlocking Fusion Weapons.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: # enum of free item at game start

starting_bonuses.name: Legacy of Uxmal
starting_bonuses.description: XCOM's Mind Fray and Psi Panic roll a second time when the first roll misses. Psi Inspire (not Psi Surge) and Telekinetic Field have a 1 turn shorter cooldown. Countercharge and Kinetic Blast deal +2 damage. Inner Fire grants +30% throw range and +3.3 mobility (from +20% and +2.0). While fewer than 20% of your soldiers have 45 or more Will, new recruits arrive with at least 45 Will.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: XCOM psionics: Mind Fray and Psi Panic re-roll a miss, Psi Inspire and Telekinetic Field -1 turn cooldown, Countercharge and Kinetic Blast +2 damage, new recruits get 45 Will while under 20% of the barracks has it

starting_bonuses.name: Advanced Conversion
starting_bonuses.description: MECs start with +1.3 base mobility, +5 base HP, +10 base aim, +20 base will, and +5 base DR. Increases the augmentation slots for MECs by 1.

starting_bonuses.name: Pax Nigeriana
starting_bonuses.description: All biosoldiers start with +1.3 base mobility.

starting_bonuses.name: Bred Tough
starting_bonuses.description: All Soldiers (Biosoldiers and MECs) start with +1 base HP and +10 base DR.

starting_bonuses.name: Soviet Zeal
starting_bonuses.description: Soldiers gain 40% more mission xp.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: Soldiers gain XP and subspec earlier

starting_bonuses.name: Uralvagonzavod
starting_bonuses.description: Basic/Alloy/Hover SHIVs gain +4/6/8 damage, respectively. All SHIVs gain +15 base DR. SHIV standard and Burst shots pass through to enemy units behind the target (up to 24 tiles, not amplified by target modifiers).

starting_bonuses.name: Roscosmos
starting_bonuses.description: Start with 4 satellites (instead of 2), +2 satellite uplink capacity, Stealth Satellites [Decreases the success chance of UFO hunting missions by 50% -- foundry must be built to benefit], and all satellites cost 60% less to build.

starting_bonuses.name: Baptism of Fire
starting_bonuses.description: No regional bonus, and all starting soldiers begin as Rookies.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: All starting soldiers begin as Rookies

starting_bonuses.name: Resourceful
starting_bonuses.description: Additional salvage teams from UFOs will recover 250% of the alloys, elerium, and weapon fragments at UFO sites without additional cost. Start with Advanced Scavenging [For a cost, scavenging teams can attain additional resources from UFOs].

starting_bonuses.name: Survival Training
starting_bonuses.description: All biosoldiers start with +4 base HP.

starting_bonuses.name: Special Air Service
starting_bonuses.description: All biosoldiers start with +8 base aim. When XCOM deploys with a soldier slot empty, biosoldiers gain +8 aim (double if 2 or more soldier slots were empty).

starting_bonuses.name: Their Finest Hour
starting_bonuses.description: Start with 3 extra interceptors. Increase interception time by 30%. All aircraft gain 10 dodge and damaged planes have no speed or aim malus. Hiring Repair Crews for damaged aircraft is twice as effective. Reduces the increased cost of housing more than 5 aircraft on a continent by 60%.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: Grants Armored Aircraft (Foundry project #) foundry project

starting_bonuses.name: MI6
starting_bonuses.description: Leather Jackets on non-Spec Ops grant Fast and Furious [After moving, if this unit still has AP remaining, the next non-movement idle-ending action costs 0 AP].
starting_bonuses.config_comment: Leather Jackets grant the Fast and Furious perk

starting_bonuses.name: Sandhurst
starting_bonuses.description: Reduce mission fatigue and missions required to unlock Officer Training School projects both by 20%. Grants an additional unit to aid in the Alien Base Assault and Exalt Base Assault.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: % reduction in total ranks for officer upgrades

starting_bonuses.name: Eagle Surveillance
starting_bonuses.description: Snipers gain +10 aim. Scouts start with 3 additional battle scanners. Your starting country's first 2 soldiers begin at SPEC rank as Marksmen (Sniper/Scout). PFC promotions go to Marksman whenever another supraclass outnumbers it.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: Scouts gain an additional 3 battle scanners

starting_bonuses.name: Special Warfare School
starting_bonuses.description: All Officer Training School projects cost 30% less. Start with Tactical Rigging [Grants one extra utility slot to biosoldier armors other than Phalanx and the Leather Jacket (max 4)],  Ammo Conservation [Grants +1 ammo to shotguns, carbines, assault rifles, SMGs, and battle rifles], High-Capacity Pistols [Grants +1 ammo to all pistols], Rail Pistols [Grants +5 aim to all pistols], and Reflex Pistols [Grants +10 crit to all pistols] (foundry must be built to benefit).
starting_bonuses.config_comment: % reduction in OTS project cash cost

starting_bonuses.name: Cheyenne Mountain
starting_bonuses.description: Start with +1 satellite uplink capacity and all elevators built. Excavation costs are reduced by 80%. Base defense starts with 6 soldiers in Delta Core (instead of 5) and 3 in the Rear Guard (instead of 4).
starting_bonuses.config_comment: % reduction in excavation cost; 3 free elevators in base

starting_bonuses.name: We Have Ways
starting_bonuses.description: Reduces time required for autopsies and interrogations by 70%. Start with Elerium Batteries [Increases Stun Rifle stun rate and gives +1 charge to the Stun Rifle, Arc Rifle, Arc Pistol, and Motion Tracker] -- foundry must be built to benefit.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: % reduction in time to complete autopsies and interrogations

starting_bonuses.name: Daredevils
starting_bonuses.description: Start with 2 extra interceptors. Pilots gain +25 crit. Combat Patrols are twice as effective, cause 50% less damage to the aircraft, and have their incremental cost reduced by 50%. Reduces the increased cost of housing more than 5 aircraft on a continent by 60%.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: Combat Patrol have a 50% chance to not increase in cost after each use and cause half as much damage to the aircraft

starting_bonuses.name: Bring the Heat
starting_bonuses.description: XCOM units gain 5% DR for each alien in sight beyond 2.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: When outnumbered by active aliens, all XCOM units gain 35% DR.

starting_bonuses.name: All Gas, No Brakes
starting_bonuses.description: RAM deals triple damage and activates after 3 tiles (instead of 6). Infantry and Assaults gain +1.3 base mobility. Your starting country's first 2 soldiers begin at SPEC rank as Tactical (Infantry/Assault). PFC promotions go to Tactical whenever another supraclass outnumbers it.
starting_bonuses.config_comment: RAM (on SHIVs and Maraduers) deals double damage.
